mentioned.quote: xAI treats AI-accelerated malicious cyber offense as a core risk domain.

threshold.note: No cyber-specific level defined; p.6 refers to 'whether a threshold has been reached' and 'risk tiers' without defining them. p.4 describes current uplift, not a trigger level.

response.quote: xAI will only proceed with the development, the making available on the market, and/or the use of the model, if the systemic risks stemming from the model are determined to be acceptable.
response.note: No threshold; acceptance criteria applied to each identified risk (p.5). Coded as response type (b) gap in ladder. Domain safeguards (pp.3-4, p.7) are present tense or 'as appropriate'.

acc_decider.note: No named role or body; p.8 'designating risk owners' and p.9 'internal governance structures' are unnamed.

acc_external.note: No binding external review. p.6 'human expert red-teaming' not stated as external; p.9 incident reports to authorities are notification only; SOC 2 (p.7) covers xAI's own information security.

acc_unmet.note: No statement of what happens if a required response is not in place or the framework is not followed; p.8 incident steps are hedged ('may'); p.9 compliance reviews are present-tense with no procedure.
